SELECT IC.CATEGORY_ID, IC.CATEGORY_NAME,
SI.SPCL_ITEM_MNG_ID, SI.ITEM_ID, SI.DISPLAY_ORDER, ( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(SPCL_ITEM_KEYWORD) FROM (SELECT SPCL_ITEM_KEYWORD FROM G_SPCL_ITEM_MNG_KEYWORD WHERE SPCL_ITEM_MNG_ID = MNG.SPCL_ITEM_MNG_ID ORDER BY REG_SEQ) ) AS KEYWORDS, I.ITEM_CODE, I.ITEM_IMAGE, I.DATA_STATUS_CODE, ( CASE WHEN I.SOLD_OUT = '1' THEN 'Y' WHEN I.ITEM_OPTION_FLAG = 'N' AND I.STOCK_FLAG = 'Y' AND I.STOCK_QUANTITY = 0 THEN 'Y' WHEN I.ITEM_OPTION_FLAG = 'Y' AND I.ITEM_OPTION_TYPE = 'T' AND I.STOCK_FLAG = 'Y' AND I.STOCK_QUANTITY = 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END ) AS ITEM_SOLD_OUT_FLAG, I.DISPLAY_FLAG, I.ITEM_USER_CODE, I.ITEM_NAME, I.SALE_PRICE FROM G_SPCL_ITEM_MNG MNG INNER JOIN G_SPCL_ITEM SI ON MNG.SPCL_ITEM_MNG_ID = SI.SPCL_ITEM_MNG_ID AND MNG.SPCL_ITEM_MNG_ID = #{specialityItemManageId} INNER JOIN OP_ITEM I ON SI.ITEM_ID = I.ITEM_ID INNER JOIN OP_SELLER S ON I.SELLER_ID = S.SELLER_ID INNER JOIN G_LOCGOV L ON S.LOCGOV_CODE = L.LOCGOV_CODE LEFT JOIN OP_ITEM_OPTION_SOLDOUT IOST ON I.ITEM_ID = IOST.ITEM_ID
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT IC.ITEM_ID, IC.CATEGORY_ID, C.CATEGORY_NAME FROM OP_CATEGORY C INNER JOIN OP_ITEM_CATEGORY IC ON C.CATEGORY_ID = IC.CATEGORY_ID AND C.CATEGORY_FLAG = 'Y' ORDER BY IC.ORDERING ASC ) IC ON I.ITEM_ID = IC.ITEM_ID
WHERE 1=1 AND I.DATA_STATUS_CODE = '1' AND I.DISPLAY_FLAG = 'Y' AND I.ITEM_DATA_TYPE = '1' AND I.ITEM_TYPE IN ('1', '3')
AND I.PRIVATE_TYPE IN (
#{privateType}
)
AND I.FRONT_DISPLAY_FLAG = 'Y' AND S.STATUS_CODE = '2' AND S.LOCGOV_CODE = MNG.LOCGOV_CODE GROUP BY I.ITEM_ID ORDER BY SI.DISPLAY_ORDER ASC

SELECT A.* , L.UPPER_LOCGOV_NM
, '전체' AS LOCGOV_NM
, L.LOCGOV_NM
FROM ( SELECT * FROM G_SPCL_ITEM_MNG
WHERE LOCGOV_CODE LIKE CONCAT(SUBSTR(#{locgovCode}, 2, 2), '%')
WHERE LOCGOV_CODE = #{locgovCode}
) A , G_LOCGOV L WHERE A.LOCGOV_CODE = L.LOCGOV_CODE ORDER BY L.LOCGOV_CODE
